Team —

I'm attaching the consolidated Q3 OKR draft and kickoff deck (attachments). This version merges input from the product and infra workstreams and highlights three decisions we need exec clearance on by EOD Tuesday so we can lock the QBR packet:

- Final success metric for Latency O2 (p90 vs p95) — proposal currently is p95.
- Confirmation of model enablement runway (which teams get early quant/opt budget).
- Approval to run a 4-week canary with dedicated dedicated capacity for top 2 customers.

Ask: please review the "Q3_OKR_draft.xlsx" sheet named "Owners + Metrics" and comment inline on Drive. Key timing: I need final sign-off (reply-all) no later than Tue 2028-06-26 17:00 PT so I can hand the bundle to Exec Ops for the QBR packet.

Quick notes:
- I moved "Traffic routing policy" under Reliability (owner: Van) and added a fallback SLA target.
- Karthik's measurement rubric is included; I highlighted one metric that needs alignment.

Links: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/q3-okr-drafts

Attachments: Q3_OKR_draft.xlsx, Kickoff_Presentation.pdf

Thanks —

Michael —

Thanks for the consolidated deck. High level: looks good. Two small edits I propose on the Owners + Metrics sheet:

- Change Reliability -> Traffic routing policy owner to "Vanessa" (just to be explicit).
- For the Latency O2 success metric, can we set the target to p95 for 99% of traffic but include a p90 baseline for low-volume tails? That gives us a runway to report progress.

I'll add comments on the doc. Once Karthik signs off on the measurement framing, I'm comfortable giving exec clearance on my side.

On canary: agree with a 4-week run but recommend we limit external customers to two and keep an internal rollback playbook.

Vanessa Ortiz
